routes.name: Barbados Entry Visa
routes.summary: Nationalities that need a visa apply and pay fully online through the immigration site. Everyone must also fill out the online Immigration and Customs form, open 72 hours before arrival.

other: Which nationalities need a visa, plus fees and stay length, were not found on the pages we could read.
Visitors need a passport valid for the whole trip, a return ticket, an address in Barbados and proof of support.

documents: Passport valid for the length of the trip
Online Immigration and Customs form receipt

routes.name: 12-Month Barbados Welcome Stamp
routes.summary: Work remotely from Barbados for up to 12 months for clients or employers outside the country. You can reapply. Holders pay no Barbados income tax.

other: Work must be location independent, for companies or clients outside Barbados.

stay.note: Valid one year, can be reapplied for.

documents: Passport-sized photo of main applicant and family over 18
routes.processing: Usually approved within 7 business days. Fee due within 28 days of approval.

routes.name: Work Permit
routes.summary: The Immigration Department processes work permits, short-term work permits and training attachments. Forms C-1, C-2 and C-3 are on its downloads page. Rules and fees were not readable online.

other: Conditions, fees and processing time not confirmed on a readable official page.

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: The Immigration Department issues non-immigrant student status. Forms H-1 to H-4 are on its downloads page. Requirements and fees were not readable online.

other: Conditions and fees not confirmed on a readable official page.

routes.name: Special Entry Permit
routes.summary: Listed as a service by the Immigration Department. Eligibility and fees were not readable online. The re-entry application form lists a fee of BDS$300 on application and BDS$300 if approved.

other: Eligibility not confirmed on a readable official page.

routes.name: Permanent Resident Status
routes.summary: Apply to the Immigration Department for Immigrant Status or Registration as a Permanent Resident (Form A1). Years required and fees were not readable online.

other: Years of residence, income and fees not confirmed on a readable official page.

routes.name: Barbadian Citizenship (registration, marriage, naturalisation, descent)
routes.summary: The Immigration Department handles registration as a citizen (including by marriage), naturalisation (Form N1) and certificates of citizenship by descent. Residence years, language and test rules were not readable online.

other: Residence years and other conditions not confirmed on a readable official page.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page.
